services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Join us for a summer of theatrical learning and creative fun with loads of performance opportunities! Summer camp programs take place at the Playhouse’s mainstage theatre complex in Eden Park/Mt. Adams and Mason Community Center. We believe theatre can be created by any person at any age. That’s what makes camp so exciting! Guided by passionate camp staff, our campers work together to make connections with audiences, each other and themselves, while learning skills that show up onstage and in real life. services.name: Show ticket
services.desc: We are Cincinnati’s national theatre. We bring diverse, engaging works of great artistry to our community and put Cincinnati's artistic excellence in the national spotlight. Yet we only exist because you keep showing up. You, our loyal audiences, play a vital role in the unique, shared experience that is live theatre. This is your Playhouse. The 2026-27 season is for you. From Pulitzer Prize winners and edge of your seat suspense to romantic comedy and rich music history, our 2026-27 season offers a variety that showcases the best of American theatre to entertain and inspire you. services.name: Youth Drama Classes
services.desc: At Playhouse, we believe theatre can be created by any person at any age. Our youth classes are designed to build confidence and develop a sense of ensemble and community. Programs focus on developing drama skills in a fun and supportive environment. Each session of classes focuses on a particular set of theatricals skills - Acting, Movement/Voice and Improvisation - and provides a rich learning experience. The class sessions build upon one another and provide a well-rounded foundation. Each child acting class tuition includes a $25, non-refundable registration fee. Cancellations prior to the first day of class will be honored with a refund, minus the $25 non-refundable registration fee.
